findings.detail: The artifact counts Legends Hospitality Holding Company as non-accrual from a footnote, but the 2025 source row has a blank Footnotes cell; the filing reports only one debt investment on non-accrual status.

citation.quoted_text: Legends Hospitality Holding Company row has a blank Footnotes cell.

rationale: The queue artifact reports two non-accrual positions, including Legends Hospitality Holding Company. The filing-level source anchor at table 16 row 10 reports only one debt investment on non-accrual status for December 31, 2025. The localized Legends source row at table 35 row 4 has a blank Footnotes cell, so the artifact footnote-based non-accrual classification for that row is unsupported; Ligado can account for the single non-accrual investment.
